name: qlrisk_check_limits
title: Limit monitoring
description: Check risk numbers against limits: utilisation and a status per limit (green, amber, red, breach; amber and red thresholds as fractions of the limit), headline metrics under node 'ALL' or per hierarchy node. For figures you already have; qlrisk_risk_report checks limits on the figures it computes. Inputs: metrics, limits; by_node and currency in `advanced`. Example: {"metrics": {"var.1d": 420000}, "limits": [{"name": "Firm VaR", "metric": "var.1d", "limit": 500000}]} gives 1 limit(s) checked: 1 amber.
